name: bear-in-mind
displayName: Bear in Mind — Copilot Token Meter
description: A pixel-art iceberg with a polar bear on it. The iceberg melts as your Copilot / LLM token burn adds up. It cannot cap your spend — the bear is relying on your compassion for that.

chatParticipants.name: iceberg
chatParticipants.description: Ask the bear about your token budget (every request you send it is counted).

iceberg.tokenBudget.description: Total token budget. The iceberg is at full size at 0 tokens used and fully melted at this many tokens. Consumption itself is measured, never entered — this is only the denominator. Agent-mode sessions resend context every turn, so real usage climbs into the millions quickly.

iceberg.trackCopilotChat.description: Automatically meter regular Copilot Chat usage by reading the exact per-request token counts VS Code records in its chat transcripts. Used as the fallback whenever OpenTelemetry is not reporting.

iceberg.otel.enabled.markdownDescription: Read the OpenTelemetry Copilot Chat emits. Run **Iceberg: Connect Copilot Telemetry…** to switch it on in Copilot Chat and point it somewhere local.

iceberg.otel.authoritative.markdownDescription: Let OpenTelemetry hold the meter whenever it is reporting, falling back to chat transcripts when it goes quiet. Turn this off to keep transcripts authoritative and treat telemetry as display-only. The two are never added together.

iceberg.otel.feedPath.markdownDescription: Path to the JSON-lines telemetry feed. Leave empty to follow `#github.copilot.chat.otel.outfile#` (or `COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH`).

iceberg.otel.tracesDbPath.markdownDescription: Path to Copilot Chat's `agent-traces.db`. Leave empty to find it automatically.

iceberg.otel.pollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to check the telemetry feed for new records.

iceberg.chatPollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to check the chat transcripts for new token counts.

iceberg.countInputTokens.description: Count input (prompt) tokens against the budget.

iceberg.countOutputTokens.description: Count output (completion) tokens against the budget.

iceberg.statusBar.description: Show remaining ice in the status bar.

iceberg.animate.description: Animate the scene. Turn off to save CPU (the scene still renders a static frame).

iceberg.pixelScale.description: Pixel size multiplier. 0 = auto-fit to the panel.

iceberg.bearName.markdownDescription: Your bear's name. `Nanuq` is Inuit for "polar bear". Run **Iceberg: Name the Bear…** for suggestions — arctic (`Siku`, `Isbjørn`, `Knut`), burn-rate puns (`Frostbyte`, `Burnie`, `Calvin`), or soft (`Teddy`, `Pudge`).
